item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00196","decision":"none","candidate_ranking":["C12","C07","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":null,"confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"none","rationale":"C12 is the strongest displayed candidate because it delegates presidential statutory authority to the same Secretary and uses closely related delegation phrasing, but that resemblance is generic to presidential delegation orders. It lacks the child's distinctive public-land machinery: designation and Federal Register publication of public land orders, required concurrence for lands administered by other agencies, Bureau of the Budget resolution of interagency disagreements, and the specific redelegation provision. No displayed candidate supplies a sufficiently distinctive or substantial drafting template; the child itself instead identifies a superseded 1943 directive as its evident antecedent.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I hereby delegate to the Secretary of the Interior the authority vested in the President by section 1 of the act of June 25, 1910","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Interior is hereby designated and empowered to perform the following-described functions of the President","explanation":"C12 shares the same official and statutory-authority delegation form, but this is standard delegation language rather than distinctive evidence of reuse."},{"child_excerpt":"No order affecting land under the administrative jurisdiction of any executive department or agency ... shall be issued ... without the prior approval or concurrence ... of the head of the department or agency concerned","parent_excerpt":"The plans of the Commission for exercising its authority under this order shall not become effective until they have been concurred in by the Secretary of Defense and the Chairman of the National Security Resources Board.","explanation":"C07 uses a concurrence limitation after delegating authority, but the mechanism, affected actors, and operative purpose differ substantially."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Interior is authorized to redelegated the authority delegated to him by this order","parent_excerpt":"The functions delegated to the Director for Mutual Security by this section 1 shall be deemed to include the authority to redelegate the functions so delegated.","explanation":"C08 contains an express redelegation clause, but this is a routine administrative device and is not paired with the child's distinctive land-withdrawal procedures."}]}
